scope: Local constructed fixtures only; no business task, model or actual service runs. Implementation untouched.

findings.problem: Explicitly incomplete initial file inventory is accepted as a valid baseline for newly changed skill bytes. Directory skill checks bypass FinalContext.files inventory guard.
findings.reproduction: Set measurement.initial_snapshot_complete=false with a valid nonempty skill package and initial_sha256={}. Current check returns PASS.
findings.expected: UnknownEvidence / UNSCORED until a usable initial baseline exists. No new mandatory complete=true legacy field is proposed.

findings.problem: Invalid initial digest values are put into old_hashes without validation, so every valid current digest differs and a skill package can falsely qualify as new.
findings.reproduction: Set initial_sha256={"unknown_file":"invalid_digest"}; current skill package returns PASS.
findings.expected: UnknownEvidence / UNSCORED for invalid baseline inventory. Preserve package-level helper/script changes as valid basic changes.

findings.problem: PDF q/Q restores text rendering mode, but the check retains the last Tr value. Visible text after Q can be treated as invisible OCR.
findings.reproduction: Content stream: q ... /I Do Q q 3 Tr Q BT /F 12 Tf 10 10 Td (Visible caption) Tj ET. Current check returns PASS although the caption paints with restored mode 0.
findings.expected: DeliveryFailure for reliably parsed visible text; track the text-rendering state stack or UnknownEvidence if state cannot be established. No OCR or subjective watermark quality check is proposed.

findings.problem: Inspected module registers minimum/count_rule and returns nonempty_items; tests use min_characters/count_mode and expect item_count. The module also lacks quotation_named_numeric_fields and additional kinds referenced by tests.
findings.reproduction: The complete valid runtime fixture with min_characters/count_mode is UNSCORED unsupported parameters; quotation kind is UNSCORED not implemented. Direct test suite additionally stops 21 cases at source identity because its fixture omits task_id.
findings.expected: Synchronize the intended implementation, compiled parameters and controls before relying on green test claims. Record exact tested implementation hashes.
findings.evidence: verification/independent_text_tests.txt: 21 failed / 1 passed on inspected bytes.

reasonable_boundaries: Renamed byte-identical initial skill packages correctly fail, while a genuine new helper file in the same package correctly passes the physical package-change condition.
Current creation is checked from same-source current-attempt create provenance. Old or foreign records cannot qualify, and separate records cannot splice creator/assignee requirements.
Changing a frozen recipient through resolved_parameters correctly produces UNSCORED rather than adopting output as gold.
These controls prove limited basic mechanical evidence only. They do not certify actual benchmark delivery, business correctness, skill semantic content, visual quality, or scheduler execution.

Legacy baseline schema can support a complete inventory without a newly invented mandatory complete=true flag; an explicit incomplete=false condition in these fixtures refers to initial_snapshot_complete=false and must be honored.
